title: Diagnostic Hub: consolidated failed-request surface for quick triage
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a single 'Diagnostic Hub' view inside Redwood Console that helps engineers and SREs triage failed inference requests quickly. The hub consolidates failed request groups, a compact error taxonomy, retry/cohort visualization, payload snapshots (structured + raw), quick links to traces/logs, and actions (reprocess, pin, create incident). This ticket covers high-fidelity prototype, micro-interactions for payload inspection, and a short usability run with 6 internal engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Hub surface shows a ranked list of recent failed request groups (by volume and recent spike) with one-line cause summary
Clicking a group opens a right-side detail pane with: grouped stack traces, representative payload snapshot (structured view first), retry history, and links to trace/log in Observability
Payload viewer supports toggle between 'Parsed (JSON with schema hints)' and 'Raw', with syntax highlighting and field-level copy actions
Error taxonomy chips let users filter failures (e.g., ModelOOM, NetworkTimeout, InvalidInput, AuthError) and persist filters to route/bookmark
Prototype includes micro-interactions for expanding payload fields, copying sample inputs, and initiating a reprocess request (stubbed)
Design tokens, spacing, and component variants align with Console design system and include accessible color contrast for error severities
design_notes: Group keys are heuristics based on: status code, first stack frame, model-id, last-runner-node, and top-k common token prefixes
Representative payload chosen as most-frequent schema or most-recent depending on user preference (setting in header)
Retry visualization is a small inline sparkline aggregated by minute + an action to expand into timeline view for selected group
We keep raw payload view by default collapsed for PII consideration; 'Reveal' requires permission from role or a quick redaction hint
Compact detail pane should be keyboard-navigable and support deep-linking via URL params for sharing with teammates
decisions: Use a right-side flyout (instead of modal) to maintain list context and enable quick back-and-forth comparisons
Show parsed/structured payload first with schema hinting (type badges) to reduce cognitive load for engineers
Implement taxonomy as first-class filters rather than tags in the UI—chip set pinned to hub header
Action buttons (Reprocess / Create Incident / Link Traces) are contextual and disabled when downstream APIs return 403 or client lacks permission
open_questions: What is the default retention window for 'Recent failures' in the hub? (30d vs 7d) — PM to decide with infra costs
Do we permit full raw payload downloads for SSO-only orgs by default? Security to confirm data handling policy
Should we expose automated root-cause suggestions (ML-driven) in v1 or keep this as future enhancement?
What exact failure grouping algorithm should be used by backend (deterministic keys vs clustering) — dependency on ENG-3012
